name: dom-review
description: Connect Codex to DOM Review annotations in the user's current Chrome session through WebMCP.

interface.shortDescription: Fix and verify Chrome UI annotations through WebMCP
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the DOM Review Chrome extension through Google's official Chrome DevTools MCP bridge. Read, update, delete, focus, and verify page-scoped UI annotations while keeping extension data local to the user's browser.
defaultPrompt: Read my open DOM Review annotations, fix them, verify the result, and update their statuses.
